hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||"")}catch(e){}})'); case "$f" in *.css|*.tsx) npm run --silent lint >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
